# Hugo Narrow 2.0.1

Patch release for Hugo Narrow 2.0.

## Fixes

- Fixed section and pagination links when the site is deployed under a subpath. The home page "View all" links, featured project links, pagination, menu fallback URLs, and the 404 home link now include the site base path.
- Reduced the collapsed dock capsule to the size of a single dock item.
- Reworked dock icons so the collapsed menu, expanded menu, and table of contents are visually distinct.
- Built a v1 demo into the main GitHub Pages site at `/v1/` so the legacy branch remains previewable.
- Restored documentation, demo, and Chinese README links in both README files.

## Compatibility

There are no breaking changes. See the [2.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/tom2almighty/hugo-narrow/releases/tag/v2.0.0) for the 2.0 breaking-change and migration list.
